notable_absence.finding: Confirms the credential-type/privilege pair model from round 2 extends to collection DDL, but with a different Advanced-side privilege ('Scope Admin') than the index-statement pages ('Query Index') - the Basic side stays 'Write' throughout. This suggests the model is a full per-operation privilege catalog keyed by credential type, not just the single Basic-write/Advanced-query-index pair implied by the round-2 sample; see cross_component_finding on createfunction.json and createsequence.json for further variants (Query Manage, Query Manage Sequences, Global Function Manage, Query Delete, Query Read).

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known issue docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: the WITH clause section states 'In clusters using Couchbase Server 7.6 and later, you can use the optional WITH clause to specify additional options for the collection', citing a literal server version on a Capella page.
